question.text:
Consider the following ionization enthalpies of two elements 'A' and 'B'.
 
Element Ionization enthalphy kJ/mol
  1st 2nd 3rd
A 899 1757 14847
B 737 1450 7731


Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Both 'A' and 'B' belong to group-1 where 'A' comes below 'B'.
Both 'A' and 'B' belong to group-2 where 'A' comes below 'B'.
Both 'A' and 'B' belong to group-1 where 'B' comes below 'A'.
Both 'A' and 'B' belong to group-2 where 'B' comes below 'A'.

solution.text: Both 'A' and 'B' belong to group-2, because the 3<sup>rd</sup> ionization energy is very high, it means 3<sup>rd</sup> electron gets removed from internal shell and where 'B' comes below 'A', because on moving from top to bottom in group the ionization energy decreases.
